scope.no_authoring_before: Parent records the C1 implementation, prompts, policy and source dependencies freeze; parent then delegates source/question/oracle authoring separately.
scope.validation_gate: A distinct custodian may register and author fresh validation families only after the preregistered calibration selection gate passes.

composition.note: These are intended authoring slots, not completed item-level answerability or semantic judgments.

family_definition.public: One coherent source project/topic lineage is one family. Different dates, revisions, translations or related documents do not create additional families.
family_definition.synthetic: One independently invented domain, entities and decision history is one family. Renamed people, changed numbers or translated templates do not create additional families.
family_definition.within_family_dependence: Each two-item pair is correlated; eight items represent four source families, not eight independent families.

quality_dimensions.multifacet: At least two explicitly requested parts must each be supported; correctness of one part does not complete the item.
quality_dimensions.multisource: At least two distinct source documents must be necessary to complete the item; decorative extra citations do not count.
quality_dimensions.status_and_conditions: Distinguish documented state, intention, scope and conditions without assuming an event occurred.
quality_dimensions.document_changes: Use explicitly documented revision or decision history; newer text is not automatically proof that a stated change was executed.
quality_dimensions.insufficient_evidence: Some useful evidence is present but at least one unambiguous required part is absent; no empty-evidence shortcut and no ambiguity/conflict substitute.

reproduction_and_authoring_rules.public_retrieval: After the C1 code/policy freeze, retrieve only the four registered raw URLs. Verify byte count, SHA-256 and Git blob identity before creating source files; never substitute a live branch or rendered website revision.
reproduction_and_authoring_rules.public_processing: Retain the original source bytes separately. Select whole source passages with heading context, without paraphrasing, translating, rewriting status or inventing connecting text. Record source line/offset mappings and processed hashes before any native model call.
reproduction_and_authoring_rules.public_license: Preserve the exact copyright/dedication section and source attribution with materialized raw/excerpt files; do not fetch external linked documents or images as if their rights were inherited.
reproduction_and_authoring_rules.synthetic_processing: Author independent meeting records and related documents only after freeze; mark fiction, author role, language and local hashes. No source text exists at registration.
reproduction_and_authoring_rules.question_authoring: Author all eight questions and frozen item-level oracles after family registration and policy freeze. Bind mandatory facts, allowed alternative citations, answerability, forbidden inference, language, source revision and processed hash before inference.
reproduction_and_authoring_rules.review: A separate semantic reviewer who did not implement the generation prompts reviews all items before inference. AI review is not human review.
reproduction_and_authoring_rules.source_length: All evidence needed by an item must fit the unchanged ten-chunk/160-span and per-stage 4096-token limits, including later stage overhead. Token readiness is not yet measured; no truncation after inference begins.
reproduction_and_authoring_rules.registry_change_policy: Preserve this registration. If source integrity, license, family separation or authorability fails before item freeze, record a versioned amendment with reason; do not silently replace a family or source. After inference begins, no item replacement or oracle edits.
